title: Reward calculation
judgements_description: Each subject is judged independently. The table maps observed states to a raw score and propagation eligibility.
lookup_reference: Inspect the six-row table used in this evaluation
lookup_note: Effective outcome = adequate process AND observed outcome. An understanding failure receives zero before lookup. Only row 1 qualifies for propagation; its numerical score comes from the recorded profile.
propagation_description: A failed dependency zeros only its dependent subjects. Independent branches in the same hop retain their own scores. Select a subject to inspect its evidence.
averages_description: Zeroed subjects remain in the hop denominator. Task and Base averages use the recorded hierarchy, rather than flattening all subjects.
concepts_title: What subject, task, and hop mean
costs_title: Violation costs and normalized group scores
costs_description: Each evaluated criterion contributes weight × (1 − value). Group costs pass through the recorded exponential profile.
quality_title: Weight quality groups and compute deduction
quality_description: Only active groups enter the quality average. Their combined quality determines the deduction from Base.
reward_title: Clip to the configured reward interval
reward_description: The final scalar follows the configured bounds. An invalid evaluation does not produce a training reward.
evidence_description: Evidence links open the exact recorded event or artifact. Input, judge reasons, and trace content are preserved in their original language.
footer: Reward Every Effort · A self-contained evaluation record. This page makes no model or network calls.
no_request: No request was recorded. Inspect evaluation issues below.
subject: Subject
no_graph: No derived task graph is available. Inspect the conversation branch or incomplete subject judgements.
subject_definition: The smallest scoring unit: an action on an object, plus its constraints and direct input–output dependencies. Produced by Labeler.
task_definition: A weakly connected component of the subject dependency graph. Derived by the runtime.
hop_definition: A topological layer within one task. Subjects in the same hop are independent; each needs only its own upstream outputs. Derived by the runtime.
position_note: S / T / H labels are display positions, not required subject IDs.
no_checks: No matching criteria. Change the filters to see other results.
no_groups: No quality groups were scored. Inspect criterion states before using the evaluation.
inactive_note: Not applicable items have no cost. Missing evidence and execution errors are unresolved, not zero-cost passes.
curve_note: Recorded profile: H={h}, C_max={c}. Points represent recorded group scores.
no_profile: Profile parameters were not recorded; the calculation remains unavailable.
no_active_default: No active groups: the recorded default quality is
not_training: This evaluation cannot be used as a training reward.
no_trace: No events or artifacts were recorded.
graph_hint: Select a subject to inspect its judgements
gate_no_policy: No Gate policy was configured for this record.
bonus_no_policy: No Bonus policy was configured for this record.
pipeline_note: Select a flow node to inspect its recorded calculation.
stage_skipped: This stage was not executed on the selected scoring path.
flow_title: Gate, Base, Deduct, Bonus and final reward
not_recorded_note: This record does not contain the stage decision or composition. No values are inferred.
gate_route_note: Gate rule {rule} supplied the reward directly. Base, Deduct and Bonus did not run.
import_help: Open saved evaluation records as JSON or JSONL (up to 20 MB). Files stay in this browser. To score a new raw trajectory first, run ree score.
import_empty: Paste or choose at least one evaluation record.
import_too_large: The input exceeds 20 MB. Split it into smaller files.
import_number: The data contains a non-finite number.
import_syntax: Invalid JSON or JSONL at line {line}. Check the JSON syntax.
import_raw_case: This is an unscored trajectory. Run ree score your-case.json --output result.json, then open result.json here.
import_status: Expected evaluation status ok or invalid.
import_read_error: Could not read this file. Choose a readable JSON or JSONL file.
group_not_scored: This group did not enter quality aggregation. Its recorded checks remain available below.
import_score: {name} must be a finite number or null.
import_reasoning_ref: metadata.display_reasoning may target only response or observed assistant message/tool-call refs.
reasoning_display_only: External model log, shown for reading; excluded from scoring evidence.
criterion_cost_note: Evaluated checks contribute weight × (1 − score). Not applicable checks are excluded; missing evidence and errors remain unresolved.
group_cost_note: This is the total over all evaluated checks in this group. Filters do not change scoring. The recorded group score follows the exponential conversion below.
quality_average_note: Overall quality is the weighted contribution total divided by the active group weight total.
quality_unresolved_note: These are subtotals for scored groups. Overall quality remains unavailable until unresolved groups are evaluated; they are not treated as excluded.
group_costs_note: Costs are summed within each group, then converted to group scores.
